SUPO, where required). About the Role We are looking for an Satellite Systems, Software & RF Production Team Lead to own the final verification of our satellites, the stage where an integrated spacecraft is proven to work. Once a satellite has been integrated, your team takes over: full satellite-level verification (functional and end-to-end system checkout), onboard software loading, validation, RF testing and characterization in the anechoic chamber and checkout. You will lead a multidisciplinary team across systems, software and RF, responsible for proving that every onboard system performs reliably before the satellite ships. This is a hands-on leadership role at the core of our production. You'll spend time on the floor with your team, solving problems, improving processes, and delivering satellites at scale. We are rapidly scaling our production operations and require a leader who can build the systems and processes necessary to support this significant growth. In this role, you carry the ultimate responsibility for flight readiness: verifying that every component is perfectly integrated and engineered to survive the uncompromising environment of space. Who We Are ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. Your day-to-day responsibilities Leading Satellite Verification Own satellite-level verification once integration is complete, functional and end-to-end system checkout; Prove that all onboard systems (RF, avionics, power, software) perform reliably in full configuration; Be hands-on: lead troubleshooting, unblock issues, keep momentum. Owning Software in Production Own onboard software loading, validation, and checkout during production verification; Maintain and improve test automation, scripts, and software-supported verification flows; Coordinate software-related troubleshooting with AIT engineering. Owning RF Test & Characterization Lead RF testing and characterization of subsystems and the full satellite in the anechoic chamber; Own RF measurement setups using spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, signal generators, power meters, etc.; Ensure RF test benches and chamber setups are maintained, calibrated, and compliant. Driving Quality, Traceability & Compliance Own planning, execution, and reporting of system-level functional tests and inspections; Maintain configuration control, build discipline, and full traceability; Ensure compliance with aerospace and RF quality standards (ECSS, NASA-STD, etc.); Ensure active team participation in root cause analysis (led by AIT Engineering) by identifying key non-conformances, ensuring critical issues are communicated, and driving the resolution of the most impactful non-conformances for the production line. Building Scalable, Repeatable Processes Develop and improve work instructions, test procedures, and checklists with AIT Engineering and Quality; Turn unclear inputs into clear, usable verification processes; reduce tribal knowledge; Drive throughput and reduce rework while protecting quality. Leading & Developing the Team Lead, coach, and grow a multidisciplinary team across RF, systems, and software; Build a culture of ownership, accountability, and pride in the product; Train and mentor on RF assembly/test best practices and fault diagnostics. Working Across Teams & Scaling Act as the bridge between verification and engineering (RF, systems, software, AIT); Collaborate with Quality, Planning, Supply Chain, and the other two production teams (Integration/Mechanical & Thermal; Electronics); Prepare verification for higher volumes; define and track KPIs. What We're Looking For Experience leading technical test/verification teams in a hands-on environment; Experience in functional and system-level testing of complex systems; Comfort with software in test, flight software loading/validation, test automation, scripting; RF background: components, antennas, waveguides, RF integration flows, and complex RF system testing; Experience with RF test tools (spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, signal generators, power meters, anechoic chambers); Ability to read and interpret RF schematics, assembly drawings, and test procedures; Working knowledge of ECSS/NASA-STD quality and workmanship requirements; A hands-on mindset, strong cross-functional collaboration, and continuous-improvement focus; Strong communication across engineers, technicians, and stakeholders. What Success Looks Like Every satellite is verified reliably, predictably, and to standard before it ships; RF, system, and software verification processes are clear, structured, and scalable; Problems are isolated and solved at the root, not patched; The team takes full ownership of verification quality and traceability; Verification keeps pace with ICEYE's growth. Why This Role Is Interesting You own the moment of truth, proving the satellite works end-to-end; You'll bring RF, systems, and software verification together under one scope; You'll shape how verification is done, not just follow existing processes; You'll work at the intersection of engineering and production, where decisions have immediate impact; Application Process Talent Acquisition Interview; Hiring Manager General Interview; Technical Interview, including a Technical Challenge; Peer & Culture Interview; VP Interview. Working at ICEYE At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win. How We Work (Our Values) Make the impossible possible : We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. Understand the “why” behind decisions; See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins. Benefits Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Within the Data Processing Systems Engineering Competence Area (DP S&A) of the Satellite System Ground Segments Division (SGS) Division, the Data Processing Systems Engineers support the design, development/upgrade, verification and validation of Data Processing systems including the associated procurements and support their maintenance and evolutions during the operations phase. For the first years, the post holder is expected to primarily contribute to the transition of the new missions from development to operations. You will work in an environment led by innovation and excellence. Joining EUMETSAT will give an unpaired opportunity to develop your professional path in satellite data processing. We are seeking a highly motivated, results-oriented person to join our dynamic team as a key player in driving our organization’s growth and success. If you are a collaborative team player with a proven track record of driving results and are looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, we encourage you to apply for this exciting role. What you’ll be doing Define and maintain requirements and specifications in support to the development of new Data Processing systems or for upgrades to existing systems; Contribute and follow-up the related developments/procurements and their integration into full scale Data Processing Systems and/or Ground Segments; Contribute to the definition of, execution and follow up of Integration and Verification & Validation (IV&V) testing of new or evolved Data Processing Systems and Applications; Support the scheduling and prioritisation of tasks, and the assessment of the adequacy of deliverables from other teams, organisations or industrial suppliers; Contribute to the definition, planning and execution of the transition and handover of Data Processing Systems from the development phase to routine maintenance and operations; Support the Data Processing Systems and Applications Competence Area Manager in defining long term plans and roadmaps to harmonise engineering, maintenance and evolutions of Data Processing Systems across all satellite systems exploited by EUMETSAT.
